victory.caption: TRAIL CAM 03  02:14
victory.text: On trail cam after trail cam, the dead stop mid-stride, and fall.

victory.caption: GROUND ZERO  02:15
victory.text: The portal, humming all this time, flickers, and goes dark.

victory.caption: DAWN
victory.text: The comms room door opens. Ellen, Wyatt and Junie come out into the first light to meet you.

victory.speaker: Junie
victory.text: Is it over? Dad, is it really over?

victory.speaker: Ellen
victory.text: Whatever was coming through... it's quiet now. It's quiet.

victory.speaker: Wyatt
victory.text: We held it. All of us.

defeat.speaker: Ellen
defeat.text: Tom? Tom, can you hear me?
